banners.plugin: Plugins (.rplugin) run sandboxed on servers using the Rustic Server engine. A faulty plugin is disabled; the server keeps running.

native.hint: A native mod is Rust code compiled into the game on your PC before it runs.
native.title: A native mod
native.body: Native mods are Rust source code built into your game on this PC (it can take from a minute to half an hour). Admins review every version before it is public.
native.how: Rustic Launcher compiles them on your PC into this instance's own game, after you accept a trust notice. The first build takes 10 to 15 minutes; later ones only recompile what changed. Instances without native mods keep the prebuilt game.
native.instanceOnly: Native mods go into an instance.

trust.title: Native code: read before you build
trust.lead: {{name}} is a native mod: Rust code compiled into the game of “{{instance}}” on this PC.
trust.unsandboxed: Native mods are not sandboxed. Once built, they run with your rights and can read, change or send anything your account can.
trust.review: Only mods from Horizon’s registry (reviewed by its maintainers) and admin-approved mods from Rustic’s marketplace can be installed. A review lowers the risk; it doesn’t remove it.
trust.build: Rust is installed if needed, then the game is compiled for this instance: about 10 to 15 minutes and a few GB the first time, faster afterwards.
trust.scope: Only this instance plays the built game. You won’t be asked again for its next native mods.
trust.check: I understand that native mods run unsandboxed with my rights, and I trust this mod.
trust.accept: I trust it: install and build

toolchain.title: Install Rust {{version}}?
toolchain.lead: Building native mods needs the Rust compiler. Rustic Launcher can install it for you.
toolchain.manual: Building native mods needs the Rust compiler and system tools Rustic Launcher can’t install for you. Install these, then build again:
toolchain.where: From the official site (static.rust-lang.org), checked against its published SHA-256, into the launcher’s own folder: nothing changes elsewhere on your PC.
toolchain.size: About 1 to 2.5 GB (with a C compiler on Windows).
toolchain.once: Once for every instance; removing the launcher’s data removes it.
toolchain.startedHint: The build starts as soon as it is ready. Follow it in the downloads panel.

build.startedHint: Follow it on the instance page or in the downloads panel. The first build takes 10 to 15 minutes.
build.failed: The native mods of {{instance}} could not be built

errors.notEdition: Native mods only build into the Rustic edition: switch this instance to it in its settings.
errors.running: Close the game first: its native mods are rebuilt while it is stopped.
